title: Palindrome Linked List
statement:
Given the head of a singly linked list, return `YES` if it is a palindrome, or `NO` otherwise.

Solve this in O(N) time and O(1) extra space by finding the middle, reversing the second half, and comparing.
inputFormat:
Line 1: an integer N.
Line 2: N space-separated integers.

examples.explanation: Reads the same forwards and backwards.

starterCode.python:
n = int(input())
a = list(map(int, input().split()))
# Check if palindrome in O(N)
